items.name: base
items.title: Base
items.description: Tokens, colourways, the paper grain, surfaces, Serigraph's own fonts (embedded in the stylesheet), the appearance runtime and cn. Every other item builds on it; make src/serigraph/styles/serigraph.css your Tailwind entry.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Accordion: rows of questions or sections that open one at a time, so a long page of answers stays easy to scan.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Alert: tells people something they should know now: a small plane with a sparkle or an icon by its title.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Alert dialog: asks for a decision before something that cannot be taken back, and waits for an answer.

items.name: arch-frame
items.title: Arch Frame
items.description: Arch frame: frames a picture or a drawing under a round arch, the way the poster looks out through its windows.

items.name: article-01
items.title: Article 01
items.description: Article: a journal post: a lettered title, the date with a raised ordinal, prose at the reading measure, a folly in an arched frame and a pull quote.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Aspect ratio: a frame that keeps its proportions as it resizes, holding a tinted well in place until the picture it frames has loaded.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: Attachment: a file handed over with a message, as a small pill: what it is, how big, and whether it has arrived.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Avatar: stands for a person: their picture or initials in a circle of spot colour, or a medallion drawn from their name.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Badge: a small flat pill in the mono face, in the highlight, a tone, rose or just the line.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Breadcrumb: where a page sits in the site, as a trail of links back up to its sections.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: Bubble: one turn of a conversation: your words in the highlight, the other side’s in a tone, each a small plane in the ink line.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button: pills in the colourway's colours inside one ink line, words in extended capitals; a short contour appears under the pointer and the fill steps to its shade when pressed.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Button group: related actions joined in one pill with a fine line between them, so a toolbar reads as a single control.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Calendar: a printed month for choosing a night or a run of nights, and the date pickers built from it.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Card: a plane in the colourway's colour or a tone, one ink line and the big radius.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Carousel: a row of slides to leaf through one at a time, such as the objects worth finding in tonight's sky.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Chart: recharts printed like the poster: flat shapes in the ink line, series told apart by flat, stippled and louvered fills as well as colour.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox: a rounded square that takes the highlight and a fine ink tick.

items.name: cloud-band
items.title: Cloud Band
items.description: Cloud band: ends one section and opens the next: a seeded cloud bank on a flat baseline whose clouds run on into the section below.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Code block: code or data in mono on a tinted plane, with line numbers, calm highlighting and a copy button.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Collapsible: a section that opens and closes in place, for detail a reader asks for rather than reads by default.

items.name: colourway-switcher
items.title: Colourway Switcher
items.description: Colourway switcher: changes how the whole page prints, its colourway, poster mat, line and grain, at once, and remembers the choice for the next visit.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Combobox: a field that filters a list as you type, for finding one telescope, or several objects, in a list too long to scroll.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Command: a searchable index of the observatory, for jumping to a session, a planet or an action by typing.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Context menu: the actions on one thing, opened where the pointer is with a right-click or a long press.

items.name: dashboard-01
items.title: Dashboard 01
items.description: Dashboard: the observatory's week: four figures in mono, visitors per night and seats by kind of session in Serigraph's fills, tonight's sessions and the bookings ahead.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Dialog: a task that needs full attention before returning to the page: a plane centred over a fine screen of ink dots.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: Direction: tells every primitive which way the page reads, so menus, sliders, segmented controls and keyboard arrows follow right-to-left text.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Drawer: a plane pulled up from the edge of the screen for a quick task on a phone, dismissed by swiping it back.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Dropdown menu: a list of actions or view options that opens from a button and closes once one is chosen.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: Empty: what a place shows when it has nothing in it yet: a doorway drawn from a seed, a title, one line on why, and the one action that helps.

items.name: empty-01
items.title: Empty 01
items.description: Empty states: a first run, a search with no results and nothing booked, each the doorway folly, one line and one action.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Field: keeps a label, its control, a description and an error together in one readable column, for building forms.

items.name: follies
items.title: Follies
items.description: The Follies engine, framework-free: seeded surreal architecture in cloud banks, drawn as SVG strings on a server, at build time or in the browser. folly({ template, seed }) draws the city, a window, a medallion, a band, the arcade wall or a doorway, filled from the colourway's roles.

items.name: folly
items.title: Folly
items.description: Folly: a seeded drawing from the Follies engine as inline SVG that fills its box and reprints in every colourway. The same seed draws the same SVG on the server and in the browser.

items.name: hero-01
items.title: Hero 01
items.description: Hero: a lettered name over a city the visitor can reroll, one sentence, two actions and the install command.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Hover card: a glance at what a link points to, such as a host or a planet, shown while the link is hovered or focused.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Input: a pill tinted from the surface beneath, 16px text, a rose second ring when invalid.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Input group: one field pill shared by an input and its units, icons or buttons, for values that need a word or an action beside them.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input Otp
items.description: Input OTP: one tinted box per digit for a short one-time code, such as the sign-in code Meridian sends its members.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: Item: an open row for one thing in a list: a medallion, an icon or a figure, a title, one line about it and its actions.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Kbd: names a key or a shortcut: the key in the mono face inside a small pill with the line.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Label: names the control beside it in the reading voice.

items.name: lettering
items.title: Lettering
items.description: Lettering: display words in Serigraph Display, paper with an ink outline and the inline line inside each stem.

items.name: letters
items.title: Letters
items.description: The skeleton alphabet behind Serigraph's fonts, as framework-free data and geometry: the centrelines and pens of every capital, figure and mark. The fonts already come with base; add this to draw the letters yourself.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: Marker: a line in a thread that is not a message: the day, where unread messages begin, or something that happened.

items.name: medallion
items.title: Medallion
items.description: Medallion: sets a featured figure in a round frame: a picture or a seeded medallion drawing, shaded with fine stipple on its shadow side.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Menubar: a row of menus along the top of an app, for the commands of a desktop tool such as the dome's show console.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: Message: one turn in a conversation: who wrote it and when, what they said, and what can be done with it.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: Message scroller: the scrolling column of a conversation: it keeps the newest message in view and offers a way back when you read up.

items.name: motif
items.title: Motif
items.description: Motif: a pinwheel, a sparkle, a cloud or an archway from the Follies engine, an em tall beside text unless sized, in its colourway role or --motif.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: Native select: picks one value with the platform's own list, best on phones: a field with a chevron over the browser's select.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Navigation menu: a site's main links, with panels that open to show the pages in each section; the page you are on takes the highlight.

items.name: ordinal-date
items.title: Ordinal Date
items.description: Ordinal date: prints a date as the poster does, THURSDAY 5TH NOVEMBER in the extended capitals with the ordinal raised.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Pagination: moves through a long list a page at a time, such as the archive of past sessions.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Popover: holds a few details or one small task beside the control that opened it, on a plane that grows from it.

items.name: poster-card
items.title: Poster Card
items.description: Poster card: features one event under an arch window with a folly in it, the title lettered below; use it sparingly.

items.name: pricing-01
items.title: Pricing 01
items.description: Pricing: three memberships on planes of their own colour, a monthly or yearly price in mono, what each includes ticked, and questions in an accordion.

items.name: programme-list
items.title: Programme List
items.description: Programme list: lists what is on, like the bill on a poster: the date with its raised ordinal, the title in the caps or lettered, and the facts between middle dots.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Progress: shows how far a task has gone: a pill slot that fills with louvers of the action colour and ink.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: Questionnaire: a short run of questions answered one at a time, such as choosing a telescope for tonight.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Radio group: picks one of a few options shown together: circles that take the highlight and a solid ink dot.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Resizable: panels side by side or stacked, divided by one fine line you can drag to give one of them more room.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Scroll area: a region that scrolls inside a fixed frame, with a thin ink thumb that stays out of the way of its content.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Select: picks one value from a list too long to show at once: a field with a chevron that opens a plane of options.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Separator: divides content inside a group: one fine line across it, or the same line turned between items in a row.

items.name: settings-01
items.title: Settings 01
items.description: Settings: a narrow settings column: profile, preferences, appearance, emails as switches, and closing the account behind an alert dialog.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Sheet: a plane laid against one edge of the window, for a session's details or a short task beside the page it came from.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Sidebar: an app's main navigation in a column beside the page, which folds to icons on a desktop and becomes a sheet on a phone.

items.name: sign-in-01
items.title: Sign In 01
items.description: Sign in: email and password on a plane with errors under their fields, keep me signed in, and a link by email instead, beside an arched window.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Skeleton: holds the place of content still loading: a tint in that content's own shape, breathing slowly.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Slider: sets a value or a range by dragging along a line, such as the dome's light: the thumb is a pinwheel that rolls as it goes.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: Sonner: brief notes that confirm what just happened, or offer to undo it, without taking anyone away from what they were doing.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Spinner: says something is on its way: a pinwheel turning at a steady pace, announced as loading.

items.name: stair-stepper
items.title: Stair Stepper
items.description: Stair stepper: shows where someone is in a few steps, drawn as a stair seen from the side: done steps louvered, the current step in the highlight.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Switch: a pill track whose pinwheel thumb rolls the distance it slides.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Table: records that compare across columns: heads in capitals over a fine line, rows divided by the same line, figures that line up.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs: a row of archways standing on their panel; the chosen arch takes the panel's colour and opens into it. A line variant for compact and vertical lists.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Textarea: a few lines of text, such as a note with a booking: the field's tint in a rounded box that grows as you write.

items.name: ticket-stub
items.title: Ticket Stub
items.description: Ticket stub: shows a booked seat as a printed ticket: a plane in a tone with a stub behind a tear line, the number in mono and ADMIT ONE.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Toggle: a button that stays down while a mode is on, such as red-light mode: a pill that takes the highlight when pressed.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Toggle group: a row of toggles: joined, the segmented control for two to four choices; spaced, a set of filters that switch on and off.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Tooltip: names a control, or defines a term, in a small ink pill while it is hovered or focused, or held on a touch screen.

items.name: trace
items.title: Trace
items.description: Trace: the steps an assistant took to reach an answer, numbered in order, each one open for its detail.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: Typography: a prose container that typesets plain long-form content, such as an observatory's newsletter or a guide, without a class on every element.

items.name: use-highlighted-code
items.title: Use Highlighted Code
items.description: Use Highlighted Code, in the Serigraph style.

items.name: serigraph
items.title: Serigraph
items.description: Every part of Serigraph: the base, the Follies engine and every component.
